comments.author: Jiblet
comments.body_html:
Ok, I’ve spent a few hours looking at this and in short, it’s not feasible to make it a special slot item.

It’s possible, but the Tarkov GUI doesn’t handle having containers in the special slots very well.

See here where I got an Injector case (a 1x1 item with a 5x5 contents) into the special slot and it keeps it open 100% of the time and doesn’t let you see most of the container.

Not great eh?

Sooo… I made a new mod to allow you to configure your pocket sizes, gave myself some cargo pants and put an ammo case in one of the long pockets

It’s by both accident and design…

Accident: Most of this code is based on the “Medical SICC” mod, a 2x1 item

I could make the size (both external and internal) configurable in the conf file if you like? Then people can balance it themselves how they see fit and I’ll leave the default at 2x1/9x9
